macros.name: gothamDividedPicBottomIncr
macros.doc: \gothamDividedPicBottomIncr controls the increment toward the left direction for the bottom splitting point.

macros.name: gothamDividedPicTextWidth
macros.doc: \gothamDividedPicTextWidth controls the width of the text on the titlepage (for the divided style).

macros.name: gothamDividedPicTop
macros.doc: \gothamDividedPicTop controls the distance between the top right corner and the top splitting point.

macros.name: gothamtitlepagebg
macros.doc: \gothamtitlepagebg The command to insert the background title page.

macros.name: gothamtitlepagelogo
macros.doc: \gothamtitlepagelogo The command to insert the institute logo(s) on title page.

macros.name: sectionhoffset
macros.doc: \sectionhoffset controls the horizontal offset of the (section title + progress bar) block.
